title: Syrinx
description: Application golden signals from HTTP/DB traces, otelsql pool metrics, and syrinx.* business counters. Host CPU/memory/disk live on the separate Host Metrics dashboard.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: HTTP server spans in the selected window

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS reqs FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2'

panels.title: Error % (5xx)
panels.description: Share of HTTP server spans with status >= 500

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN CAST(http_response_status_code AS BIGINT) >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) END AS err_pct FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2'

panels.title: p95 latency (ms)
panels.description: HTTP server span duration; stored µs, shown as ms

queries.query: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2'

panels.title: DB spans
panels.description: PostgreSQL client spans in the selected window

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS db_spans FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql'
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, count(*) AS reqs FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, count(*) AS errs FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' AND CAST(http_response_status_code AS BIGINT) >= 500 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000.0 AS p50_ms, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: DB connections (open vs max)
panels.description: Connection pool saturation. Host CPU/RAM live on the Host Metrics dashboard.

queries.query: SELECT http_route, count(*) AS reqs FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' AND http_route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY http_route ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT http_route, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms, count(*) AS reqs FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' AND http_route IS NOT NULL AND http_route != '/ws/' GROUP BY http_route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, http_response_status_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY ts, http_response_status_code ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Route latency summary
panels.description: Outliers without a heatmap — sort by p95 in the UI if needed

queries.query: SELECT http_route, count(*) AS reqs, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.5) / 1000.0 AS p50_ms, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms, avg(duration) / 1000.0 AS avg_ms FROM syrinx WHERE span_kind = '2' AND http_route IS NOT NULL AND http_route != '/ws/' GROUP BY http_route ORDER BY reqs DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Pool wait duration
panels.description: Time spent waiting for a free connection

panels.title: DB query latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: From DB spans (preferred over empty histogram_quantile buckets)

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
SELECT operation_name, count(*) AS cnt FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql' GROUP BY operation_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Slowest queries (p95 ms)
panels.description: Statement text without bind args; truncated to 120 chars

queries.query: SELECT substr(db_query_text, 1, 120) AS query, count(*) AS cnt, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms, avg(duration) / 1000.0 AS avg_ms FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql' AND db_query_text IS NOT NULL AND db_query_text != '' GROUP BY query ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: DB spans: nested vs orphan
panels.description: After context threading, DB spans should nest under the HTTP request span (reference_parent_span_id set). Orphans indicate unmigrated call sites.

queries.query: SELECT nesting, count(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN reference_parent_span_id IS NOT NULL AND reference_parent_span_id != '' THEN 'nested under request' ELSE 'orphan (no parent span)' END AS nesting FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql' ) GROUP BY nesting ORDER BY cnt DESC

panels.title: Nested DB span % over time
panels.description: Share of PostgreSQL client spans with a parent request span

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN reference_parent_span_id IS NOT NULL AND reference_parent_span_id != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) AS nested_pct FROM syrinx WHERE db_system = 'postgresql' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: DB queries per request by route
panels.description: Per HTTP request trace: count of nested DB spans, averaged by route. Requires context-threaded queries (trace_id join).

queries.query: SELECT http_route, avg(db_queries) AS avg_queries, approx_percentile_cont(db_queries, 0.95) AS p95_queries, count(*) AS requests FROM ( SELECT h.http_route, h.trace_id, count(d.span_id) AS db_queries FROM syrinx h INNER JOIN syrinx d ON h.trace_id = d.trace_id AND d.db_system = 'postgresql' WHERE span_kind = '2' AND h.http_route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.http_route, h.trace_id ) GROUP BY http_route ORDER BY avg_queries DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: DB time as % of request duration
panels.description: Sum of nested DB span durations divided by HTTP span duration, averaged per trace then over time

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS ts, avg(db_ms * 100.0 / nullif(http_ms, 0)) AS db_pct FROM ( SELECT h._timestamp, h.duration / 1000.0 AS http_ms, coalesce(sum(d.duration), 0) / 1000.0 AS db_ms FROM syrinx h LEFT JOIN syrinx d ON h.trace_id = d.trace_id AND d.db_system = 'postgresql' WHERE span_kind = '2' GROUP BY h.trace_id, h._timestamp, h.duration ) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Signups
panels.description: Successful signups by signup.mode (open / invite / closed)

panels.title: Account deletions
panels.description: Account removals on first successful cert (not replays). note.has = whether a goodbye note was supplied (never the text).

panels.title: Key revocations
panels.description: Successful key revocations; per-user series carry user.id in Explore

panels.title: Signups vs deletions
panels.description: Compare signup and account-deletion counters over the selected window

panels.title: Users with identity backup (.sxi)
panels.description: Live snapshot from DB counters (identity_backup_count > 0). Updated every metrics scrape (~10s).

panels.title: Users with full backup (.sxb)
panels.description: Live snapshot from DB counters (full_backup_count > 0). Separate from keys-only identity export.

panels.title: Backup events by kind
panels.description: Successful SPA export acknowledgements via POST /users/me/backup (after the file is saved locally)

panels.title: First vs repeat backups
panels.description: repeat=true when the user had already recorded at least one backup of the same kind (identity or full)

panels.title: Signup cohort retention (% still active by day N)
panels.description: Per-user (user_id) signup timestamp, excluded once a matching deletion timestamp exists (both from raw histogram exemplars). user_id IS NOT NULL filters out datapoints from before this label was added. Not cohort-bucketed by signup week — just 'signups from N days ago still active today', across all signups to date. Deletions include admin kicks. Reads as ~100% flat until syrinx_users_deleted has data (no deletions recorded as of authoring). extract(epoch FROM now()) and floor() verified directly against this OpenObserve instance's DataFusion SQL engine; datediff/to_unix_timestamp are NOT supported here.

queries.query: WITH signups AS ( SELECT user_id, min(_timestamp) AS signed_up_at FROM syrinx_users_created WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ), deletions AS ( SELECT user_id, min(_timestamp) AS deleted_at FROM syrinx_users_deleted WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT floor((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000000.0 - s.signed_up_at) / 86400000000.0) AS days_active, count(*) AS cohort_still_active FROM signups s LEFT JOIN deletions d ON s.user_id = d.user_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY days_active ORDER BY days_active

panels.title: Publishes by kind
panels.description: Successful SignReed creates (not replays), split by reed.kind

panels.title: Echoes sent vs received
panels.description: Echo sent = new echo reed published; targeted = original reed indexed (syrinx.echoes.targeted)

panels.title: Reed deletions
panels.description: Successful reed removal certs (not replays). No Data = no deletions in the selected window.

panels.title: Length rejections
panels.description: SignReed HTTP 400 from ReedContentWithinLimits (max raw 1400, visible 140). No Data = no rejections in the selected window.

panels.title: Publishes with tags
panels.description: Tag count bucketed 0–3 exact, 4 = four or more (never tag text)

panels.title: Reed body length (raw chars) — p50/p90/p99
panels.description: Shape of len(body) on successful publish, from OTLP histogram buckets (not just the mean). Cap is 1400 raw chars — p99 hugging the cap may indicate abuse. Bucket boundaries are SDK defaults, coarse between 100–1400; see syrinx/observability for tuning a View if more resolution near the cap is needed.

panels.title: Reed body length (visible chars) — p50/p90/p99
panels.description: Shape of CountMarkdownCharacters(body) on publish. Cap is 140 visible chars.

panels.title: Reed holders & coverage % — p50/p90/p99
panels.description: holders and coverage % are the same event (ReedCoverage records both together — coverage % = holders / active users) so they're merged here. Shape from OTLP histogram buckets instead of a flattened mean. Per-reed series (author.id + reed.id) aggregate; filter in Explore.

panels.title: Threads published
panels.description: Successful CreateThread calls (not replays), next to the reeds they contain (syrinx.reeds.published with reed.kind=thread).

panels.title: Thread size (parts) — p50/p90/p99
panels.description: Parts per thread at publish, from OTLP histogram buckets. Threads cap at 30 parts.

panels.title: WebSocket messages
panels.description: Every handled WS frame, by normalized message type

panels.title: Inbound by message type
panels.description: Client → server frames (ws.direction=in)

panels.title: Outbound by message type
panels.description: Server → client frames (ws.direction=out)

panels.title: Relay path (in vs out)
panels.description: Quick view of reed relay request/response/miss balance

panels.title: Pending relay events by lifecycle stage
panels.description: created/fulfilled/deleted samples for pending_events rows (syrinx.relay.event). created without a matching fulfilled or deleted for the same event.id means the request leaked — no holder ever answered and nothing ever cleaned it up.

panels.title: Relay events by kind
panels.description: All lifecycle stages summed together, split by event.kind

panels.title: Leaked requests (created, never fulfilled or deleted)
panels.description: Per event.id: created but never followed by a fulfilled or deleted sample in the selected window. A wide window is needed for this to be meaningful — a request created seconds ago just hasn't had time to resolve yet, that isn't necessarily a leak.

queries.query: SELECT event_kind, count(*) AS leaked FROM ( SELECT event_id, max(event_kind) AS event_kind, sum(CASE WHEN relay_lifecycle = 'created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created, sum(CASE WHEN relay_lifecycle IN ('fulfilled', 'deleted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved FROM syrinx_relay_event WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id ) WHERE created > 0 AND resolved = 0 GROUP BY event_kind ORDER BY leaked DESC

panels.title: Duplicate/wasted responses (fulfilled more than once)
panels.description: Same event.id fulfilled more than once — a holder retransmitted a RELAY_RESPONSE after the first one already satisfied the request. wasted_responses = extra deliveries beyond the one actually needed.

queries.query: SELECT event_kind, count(*) AS duplicate_events, sum(fulfilled_count) - count(*) AS wasted_responses FROM ( SELECT event_id, max(event_kind) AS event_kind, count(*) AS fulfilled_count FROM syrinx_relay_event WHERE relay_lifecycle = 'fulfilled' AND event_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ) GROUP BY event_kind ORDER BY wasted_responses DESC

panels.title: Federation relay traffic
panels.description: Every federation relay leg handled or called, either direction

panels.title: Federation relay error rate
panels.description: ok=false: non-2xx response either handling or calling a peer leg

panels.title: Relay traffic by peer server
panels.description: How much relay traffic each foreign server is generating (in) or receiving from us (out), broken down by leg. peer.server_id is this server's own DB id for the peer, not a raw domain/URL.

queries.query: SELECT peer_server_id, federation_direction, federation_leg, count(*) AS calls FROM syrinx_federation_relay WHERE peer_server_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY peer_server_id, federation_direction, federation_leg ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Admin requests opened by action
panels.description: Requests an admin signed and the server stored, awaiting a second admin

panels.title: Admin decisions
panels.description: Requests closed by approval, rejection, or the requester's withdrawal

panels.title: Admin actions executed
panels.description: Approved actions, counted once per target (once for a broadcast)

panels.title: Admin refusals by stage
panels.description: Requests or decisions the admin rules refused. A burst from one admin is the signal that their key is being misused; see the table below.

panels.title: Admin refusals by admin and reason
panels.description: Who keeps hitting admin refusals, and which rule stopped them

queries.query: SELECT actor_id, action, reason, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT actor_id, action, stage, reason, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_admin_requests_refused GROUP BY actor_id, action, stage, reason ) WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_id != '' GROUP BY actor_id, action, reason ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Admin actions by target
panels.description: Who was suspended, kicked, rebound or messaged, and by which two admins

queries.query: SELECT target_id, action, requester_id, approver_id, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT target_id, action, requester_id, approver_id, ok, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_admin_actions_executed GROUP BY target_id, action, requester_id, approver_id, ok ) WHERE target_id IS NOT NULL AND target_id != '' GROUP BY target_id, action, requester_id, approver_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Time to decision (seconds)
panels.description: Open-to-decision time for approvals and rejections

panels.title: Suspended users refused
panels.description: Requests and WebSocket handshakes from suspended accounts

panels.title: Flags raised vs dismissed
panels.description: Flags from this server's members and from peers', and admin dismissals

panels.title: Most flagged authors
panels.description: Authors whose reeds draw the most flags

queries.query: SELECT author_id, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT author_id, reed_id, reporter_id, origin, note_has, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_flags_created GROUP BY author_id, reed_id, reporter_id, origin, note_has ) WHERE author_id IS NOT NULL AND author_id != '' GROUP BY author_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Admin mail
panels.description: Approved broadcasts and private messages delivered to mailboxes

panels.title: Ledger entries
panels.description: Committed ledger entries; split by entry.kind in Explore

panels.title: Auth rejections by reason
panels.description: HTTP requests the signature-auth, server-key-proof or device middleware refused

panels.title: WebSocket handshake rejections by reason
panels.description: Refused WebSocket handshakes; internal = a server-side error, not the caller

panels.title: Auth rejections by user and key
panels.description: Keys behind the most refused requests. The key is as the caller claimed it; user is empty when the server doesn't know the key.

queries.query: SELECT key_id, user_id, reason, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT user_id, key_id, reason, route, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_auth_rejected GROUP BY user_id, key_id, reason, route ) WHERE key_id IS NOT NULL AND key_id != '' GROUP BY key_id, user_id, reason ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Auth rejections by route
panels.description: Which endpoints are being probed (mux route template)

queries.query: SELECT route, reason, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT route, reason, key_id, user_id, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_auth_rejected GROUP BY route, reason, key_id, user_id ) WHERE route IS NOT NULL AND route != '' GROUP BY route, reason ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Signup rejections by reason
panels.description: Refused signups; reserved = a name root reserved

panels.title: Username availability checks
panels.description: A spike in checks without signups suggests username enumeration

panels.title: Cooldown hits
panels.description: Key rotations and vouches refused for coming too soon

panels.title: Block refusals
panels.description: Reads and requests refused because the author blocked the viewer

panels.title: Blocked viewers who keep trying
panels.description: Viewers repeatedly refused by an author who blocked them

queries.query: SELECT viewer_id, author_id, sum(total) AS total FROM ( SELECT viewer_id, author_id, surface, max(value) AS total FROM syrinx_blocks_refusals GROUP BY viewer_id, author_id, surface ) WHERE viewer_id IS NOT NULL AND viewer_id != '' GROUP BY viewer_id, author_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Open WebSocket connections
panels.description: Sockets open right now across replicas; resets when a process restarts
